descriptions.value: In ExecuteGraphCommand of multiple files, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write via an oversized scratch memory declaration due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In userdata_report of hwcodec_firmware, there is a possible Logic error due to a logic error in the code. This could lead to local information disclosure with execution privileges needed. User interaction is for exploitation.
Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
